searchText: Curious on people's thoughts on the proper way to handle https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/3455 Things I'm weighing (seriously): 1. I very strongly believe editors should not be censoring "bad ideas" via the EIP process. That isn't our job, and I don't think it should be our (or anyone's) job. 2. EIP Editorial work is a time consuming process, and we are already stretched incredibly thin. 3. This particular EIP is "obviously trolling" but that is a really fuzzy line. 4. Spending time doing editorial work on obvious trolls is an attack vector against an already strained process. i think we had good fun and now we can close it if he reopens and insists, we can merge I won't complain if someone else closes it. I'm pretty hesitant to close it myself though. It is psychologically easier to watch someone else violate a person's freedoms than to violate those freedoms myself. 😛 (weak analogy) haha I'm imagining the scene from Monty Python (for the aged among us) where the peasant is shouting, "Help, help! I'm being repressed!" https://youtu.be/CUCaIcWp8fE I like that they make fun of the anarcho-syndicalists, forgetting that the real ones ruled Spain, holding off Franco and Hitler for three long bloody years of war.

excerpts.content:
Things I'm weighing (seriously):
1. I very strongly believe editors should not be censoring "bad ideas" via the EIP process.  That isn't our job, and I don't think it should be our (or anyone's) job.
2. EIP Editorial work is a time consuming process, and we are already stretched incredibly thin.
3. This particular EIP is "obviously trolling" but that is a really fuzzy line.
4. Spending time doing editorial work on obvious trolls is an attack vector against an already strained process.
